**Newsroom brief: If October core CPI is 0.3% or higher, gold falls at least 0.7% in 60 minutes: Capital Chronicle model estimate**

October CPI: a gold reaction map is only as useful as its rates, dollar and inflation-detail checks.

**Context:** Capital Chronicle's competing explanation is concentration: an energy-led headline rise need not establish a broader core acceleration. But September's substantial core effect also challenges an energy-only account. The next test is whether shelter and other persistent services agree with the rounded core number.

Read the article: https://capitalchronicle.substack.com/p/if-october-core-cpi-is-03-or-higher

Release schedule attributed to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS). Capital Chronicle offers analysis only, not financial advice or recommendations.

Base case: Capital Chronicle model estimate 44% for the in-line core CPI bin; modest gold relief depends on the detail and rates.
Alternative: Capital Chronicle model estimate 31% for the hot core CPI bin; gold weakness needs higher rates and a stronger dollar.

Positions we mention are model positions on a demo account.

Chart: TradingView.

If October core CPI is 0.3% or higher, gold falls at least 0.7% in 60 minutes: Capital Chronicle model estimate

October CPI: a gold reaction map is only as useful as its rates, dollar and inflation-detail checks.

Why it matters: Capital Chronicle's analysis starts with rates: a hot core reading would need a higher two-year Treasury yield and a stronger dollar to reinforce pressure on gold. A soft reading would need the opposite. A CPI surprise alone does not establish either market response.
